name: dlmnwd
description: Fast CLI utilities for running a Dolmenwood game at the table

scripts.web:build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./web/index.html --outdir dist --minify && cp -f web/og.png dist/og.png
scripts.web:single: rm -rf dist && bun build ./web/index.html --outdir dist --minify && bun run scripts/build-single.ts
scripts.check: oxfmt --check . && oxlint && bun test && bun run web:build
